title: Air traffic control
tagline: Guide every flight home, one heading at a time.
teaser: Planes enter your airspace needing new headings and altitudes. Keep them apart and bring every one of them home.

manPage.synopsis: atc — give planes headings and heights; land them and keep them apart.
manPage.description: Ed James wrote atc at UC Berkeley, based, as its manual admits, on someone’s description of a game for an unknown PC.

howToPlay: Planes enter your airspace from the edges.
Give each one a new heading and height.
Land them or send them out safely, and never let two meet.
